title: Council — CSOAI multi-model measurement panel
description: How the CSOAI council panel works: multiple models measured on published harnesses. Simulated deliberation, real measurements.
text: Council — CSOAI multi-model measurement panel Home Master Sovereign GovBench Pricing Products Council FAQ Article 50 The Council Simulated — not a live council. The panel below describes how multi-model measurement works; deliberation transcripts shown anywhere on this site are demonstrations, and every score traces to a measured run on a published harness. The council pattern routes one question to several specialist models and compares their measured behaviour — never a vote counting as truth. Correlated models voting is one model with extra steps, so the council reports measured per-model results side by side , with the harness public so you can recompute each one. What it is: a measurement panel — same frozen prompts, several models, published per-model scores with confidence intervals. What it is not: an authority, a certification body, or a decision-maker. It measures; it does not rule. Try the underlying bench: GovBench — 174 items, 26 dimensions, measured leaderboard. CSOAI Ltd · UK company 16939677 · Every published figure traces to a signed, verifiable record.

register.note: CSOAI measures and publishes evidence. It issues no conformity marks and holds no accreditation. Nothing here is certification or legal advice.
